title: Ausländerbehörde
context: You have an appointment at the Ausländerbehörde to extend your residence permit. The officer checks your documents and explains the next steps.
context_tr: Oturma izni yenileme için Yabancılar Dairesi'nde randevunuz var. Memur belgelerinizi kontrol ediyor.
opening: Guten Morgen. Nehmen Sie bitte Platz. Haben Sie alle Unterlagen dabei?

title: Anmeldung beim Bürgeramt
context: You need to register your new address at the Bürgeramt (city registration office). You bring your passport and rental contract. The clerk processes your registration.
context_tr: Yeni adresinizi Bürgeramt'a kayıt ettirmeniz gerekiyor. Pasaportunuz ve kira sözleşmenizle geldiniz.
opening: Guten Tag! Was kann ich für Sie tun?

title: Beim Finanzamt
context: You are at the Finanzamt (tax office) to ask about your tax return and understand a letter you received. The tax officer explains the process.
context_tr: Finanzamt'ta vergi beyannamesi ve aldığınız bir mektup hakkında soru sormak için bekliyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag. Bitte nehmen Sie Platz. Worum geht es Ihnen?

title: Beim Jobcenter
context: You have a mandatory appointment at the Jobcenter. The case worker asks about your job search activities, your qualifications, and discusses your Eingliederungsvereinbarung.
context_tr: Jobcenter'da zorunlu randevunuz var. Danışman iş arama faaliyetlerinizi ve niteliklerinizi soruyor.
opening: Guten Morgen. Ich bin Frau Schmidt, Ihre Arbeitsvermittlerin. Wie läuft es mit der Jobsuche?

title: Bei der Krankenkasse
context: You visit the Krankenkasse (health insurance office) to ask about coverage, register a family member, or resolve a billing issue.
context_tr: Krankenkasse ofisine kapsam bilgisi almak, aile üyesi kaydı veya fatura sorunu için gidiyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag! Wie kann ich Ihnen helfen?
goals: Register a family member or clarify a billing issue

title: Formulare ausfüllen
context: You are at a German office and need help filling out a complex official form. You don't understand some fields and ask a staff member for help.
context_tr: Resmi bir formda anlamadığınız alanlar var. Bir memurdan yardım istiyorsunuz.
opening: Brauchen Sie Hilfe beim Ausfüllen des Formulars?

title: Verpassten Termin erklären
context: You missed an important appointment at a government office. You call or visit to explain why you missed it, apologize, and try to reschedule.
context_tr: Resmi bir randevuyu kaçırdınız. Neden kaçırdığınızı açıklıyorsunuz ve yeni randevu almak istiyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag. Sie hatten letzte Woche einen Termin bei uns, sind aber nicht erschienen. Was ist passiert?
goals: Explain why you missed the appointment

title: Banktermin
context: You have an appointment at a German bank to open an account. The advisor asks about your needs, explains account types, and walks you through the paperwork.
context_tr: Hesap açmak için Alman bankasında randevunuz var. Banka danışmanı hesap türlerini açıklıyor.
opening: Guten Tag! Schön, dass Sie da sind. Sie möchten ein Konto eröffnen, richtig?
goals: Explain what kind of account you need
Ask about online banking and debit card

title: Dokumente anfordern
context: You need to officially request documents from a German authority — such as a birth certificate copy, a confirmation letter, or a transcript. You visit the relevant office.
context_tr: Resmi bir kurumdan belge talep ediyorsunuz — doğum belgesi kopyası, teyit mektubu veya transkript gibi.
opening: Guten Tag. Was kann ich für Sie tun?
goals: Request the specific document you need
Understand the cost and processing time
Ask how you will receive it

title: Beim Arzt
context: You are a patient at a German Hausarzt. You have a headache, sore throat and slight fever. Describe your symptoms and get a prescription.
context_tr: Alman aile hekiminde hastasınız. Baş ağrısı, boğaz ağrısı ve hafif ateşiniz var.
opening: Guten Tag! Was kann ich für Sie tun?

title: In der Apotheke
context: You are at a German pharmacy. You have a prescription from the doctor and also want to buy something for a cough without a prescription. The pharmacist advises you.
context_tr: Alman eczanesindeyseniz. Reçeteniz var ve ayrıca öksürük için reçetesiz ilaç almak istiyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag! Was kann ich für Sie tun?
goals: Ask for an over-the-counter cough remedy

title: In der Notaufnahme
context: You are in a hospital emergency room with a family member who has severe stomach pain. You explain the symptoms to the nurse and fill in basic information.
context_tr: Aile üyeniz şiddetli karın ağrısıyla acil servisteydiniz. Hemşireye semptomları anlatıyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Abend! Was ist passiert? Bitte beschreiben Sie die Beschwerden.

title: Beim Zahnarzt
context: You have a toothache and visit a German dentist for the first time. You explain your pain, ask about treatment options and costs, and discuss what the insurance covers.
context_tr: Diş ağrısıyla Alman diş hekimine ilk kez gidiyorsunuz. Ağrıyı anlatıyor ve tedavi seçeneklerini soruyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag! Ich sehe, Sie haben heute Schmerzen. Wo genau tut es weh?
goals: Describe where and how the tooth hurts
Ask what costs the insurance covers

title: Kind beim Arzt
context: Your child has a high fever and a rash. You take them to the Kinderarzt (pediatrician). You explain the symptoms and ask for advice.
context_tr: Çocuğunuzun yüksek ateşi ve kızarıklığı var. Çocuk doktoruna götürüyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag! Wie geht es dem Kleinen? Was sind die Symptome?

title: Beim Psychotherapeuten
context: You are having your first introductory session with a German psychotherapist. They ask about your reasons for coming and how you have been feeling lately.
context_tr: Bir psikoterapistle ilk tanışma seansındasınız. Neden geldiğinizi ve kendinizi nasıl hissettiğinizi anlatıyorsunuz.
opening: Willkommen. Ich bin froh, dass Sie den Schritt gemacht haben. Erzählen Sie mir, was Sie herführt.
goals: Describe how you have been feeling
Explain what you are struggling with

title: Vorstellungsgespräch
context: You are in a job interview at a German company. The interviewer asks about your background, experience, strengths, and why you want to work there.
context_tr: Bir Alman şirketinde iş görüşmesine katılıyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag! Vielen Dank, dass Sie gekommen sind. Erzählen Sie mir bitte etwas über sich.

title: Erster Arbeitstag
context: It is your first day at a German company. Your new colleague shows you around, introduces you to the team, and explains the daily routines and office rules.
context_tr: Alman bir şirkette ilk gününüz. Meslektaşınız sizi tanıtıyor ve ofis kurallarını açıklıyor.
opening: Herzlich willkommen! Ich bin dein Ansprechpartner für heute. Ich zeige dir alles. Hast du schon einen Kaffee?
goals: Ask about daily routines and lunch
Understand the most important office rules

title: Büro Smalltalk
context: You are in the office kitchen getting coffee. A German colleague starts chatting with you about the weekend, the weather, or current events.
context_tr: Ofis mutfağında kahve alırken bir meslektaşınız sizinle sohbet başlatıyor.
opening: Oh, auch Kaffeepause! Wie war dein Wochenende?
goals: Talk about your weekend or plans

title: Urlaubsantrag stellen
context: You want to request two weeks of vacation from your manager. You explain when you want to take it, why that period works for you, and ensure the team is covered.
context_tr: Müdürünüzden iki haftalık izin istemek istiyorsunuz. Ne zaman ve neden o dönemde istediğinizi açıklıyorsunuz.
opening: Hallo! Sie wollten mit mir sprechen?
goals: Explain who will cover your work

title: Gehaltsverhandlung
context: You have a meeting with your manager to discuss a salary raise. You explain your achievements over the past year and make a specific salary request.
context_tr: Müdürünüzle maaş zammı görüşmesi yapıyorsunuz. Geçen yılki başarılarınızı anlatıyor ve belirli bir rakam istiyorsunuz.
opening: Hallo, kommen Sie herein. Sie möchten über Ihr Gehalt sprechen?
goals: Present your case with specific achievements

title: Im deutschen Büro
context: You are in a team meeting at a German company. Your colleague presents a project update. You ask questions, give your opinion, and discuss next steps.
context_tr: Alman şirketinde ekip toplantısındasınız. Meslektaşınız proje güncellemesi sunuyor.
opening: Gut, fangen wir an. Ich möchte kurz über den aktuellen Stand des Projekts sprechen.
goals: Follow and respond to a project update

title: Mitarbeitergespräch
context: You have your annual Mitarbeitergespräch (performance review) with your manager. They give feedback on your work and you discuss goals for the next year.
context_tr: Yıllık performans değerlendirme görüşmeniz var. Müdürünüz geri bildirim veriyor ve gelecek yılın hedeflerini konuşuyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Morgen. Setzen Sie sich. Ich freue mich auf unser Jahresgespräch. Wie fühlen Sie sich in Ihrer Rolle?
goals: Reflect on your achievements this year
Discuss development goals for next year

title: Wohnungsbesichtigung
context: You are viewing an apartment in Germany. The landlord shows you around and you ask about rent, utilities, neighborhood, and the rental contract.
context_tr: Almanya'da daire gezisine gidiyorsunuz. Kira, faturalar ve sözleşme hakkında sorular soruyorsunuz.
opening: Herzlich willkommen! Die Wohnung hat 65 Quadratmeter. Kommen Sie herein!
goals: Ask about rent and extra costs

title: Mit Nachbarn sprechen
context: You meet your neighbor in the hallway. You make small talk, then politely raise a concern about noise late at night.
context_tr: Koridorda komşunuzla karşılaşıyorsunuz. Sohbet ediyorsunuz ve gece gürültüsünü kibarca gündeme getiriyorsunuz.
opening: Oh, hallo! Wir haben uns ja lange nicht gesehen!

title: Heizung defekt melden
context: Your heater broke down in the middle of winter. You contact your landlord or property manager to report the problem and arrange a repair visit.
context_tr: Kış ortasında kaloriferin bozuldu. Ev sahibine durumu bildiriyor ve tamir randevusu ayarlıyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag. Was kann ich für Sie tun?
goals: Arrange a time for the repair

title: Internetvertrag abschließen
context: You visit a Telekom or Vodafone store to set up internet at your new apartment. The advisor explains the different packages, speeds, and contract terms.
context_tr: Yeni daireniz için internet bağlatmak üzere bir operatör mağazasındasınız. Danışman paketleri açıklıyor.
opening: Hallo! Herzlich willkommen. Kann ich Ihnen helfen?
goals: Understand the contract duration and cancellation terms
Set up the service for your address

title: Mülltrennung verstehen
context: You are confused about German recycling rules. A helpful neighbor explains which waste goes in which bin and what happens on collection days.
context_tr: Alman çöp ayrıştırma kuralları kafanızı karıştırdı. Komşunuz hangi çöpün nereye gittiğini açıklıyor.
opening: Oh, Sie schauen die Mülltonnen an! Darf ich Ihnen erklären, wie das hier funktioniert?
goals: Avoid getting a fine from the Hausmeister

title: Einzug — mit dem Hausmeister
context: You are moving into a new apartment. The Hausmeister (caretaker) hands over the keys, explains the house rules, and goes through the handover protocol.
context_tr: Yeni dairenize taşınıyorsunuz. Kapıcı anahtarları teslim ediyor ve ev kurallarını anlatıyor.
opening: Herzlich willkommen! Ich bin der Hausmeister, Herr Weber. Ich gebe Ihnen gleich die Schlüssel.
goals: Receive the keys and check for damages
Understand the most important house rules
Ask about rubbish collection and parking

title: Kindergartenanmeldung
context: You want to register your child at a German Kindergarten. You speak with the educator about availability, opening hours, fees, and required documents.
context_tr: Çocuğunuzu anaokulu'na kayıt ettirmek istiyorsunuz. Yer müsaitliği, saatler ve ücretler hakkında konuşuyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag! Sie möchten Ihr Kind bei uns anmelden?

title: Gespräch mit dem Lehrer
context: You have a parent-teacher meeting about your child's progress. The teacher explains how your child is doing, what they are good at, and where they need support.
context_tr: Çocuğunuzun ilerlemesi hakkında öğretmeniyle görüşüyorsunuz. Öğretmen güçlü ve geliştirilmesi gereken alanları anlatıyor.
opening: Guten Tag! Kommen Sie herein. Ich freue mich, dass Sie heute Zeit hatten.
goals: Discuss what you can do at home to help

title: Elternabend
context: You attend a Elternabend (parent evening) at your child's school. The teacher presents plans for the year and other parents ask questions. You join the discussion.
context_tr: Çocuğunuzun okulunda veli toplantısına katılıyorsunuz. Öğretmen yıl planını sunuyor, diğer velilerle sohbet ediyorsunuz.
opening: Einen schönen guten Abend, liebe Eltern! Schön, dass Sie alle da sind. Wir beginnen mit dem Jahresprogramm.
goals: Introduce yourself briefly to other parents

title: Schulanmeldung
context: You go to the local Grundschule to register your child. The secretary explains what documents you need, the school's schedule, and the registration process.
context_tr: Çocuğunuzu ilkokula kayıt ettirmek için okula gidiyorsunuz. Sekreter belgeleri ve kayıt sürecini açıklıyor.
opening: Guten Morgen! Wie kann ich Ihnen helfen?
goals: Find out about the first day of school

vocabulary.translation: school enrolment / first day of school

title: Auf dem Spielplatz
context: You are at a German playground with your child. You start chatting with another parent. You talk about ages, schools, the neighborhood, and maybe arrange a playdate.
context_tr: Çocuğunuzla oyun alanındasınız. Başka bir veli ile sohbet ediyorsunuz. Okul, mahalle ve belki ortak aktiviteler hakkında konuşuyorsunuz.
opening: Hallo! Ihr Kind ist so süß! Wie alt ist es?
goals: Talk about your children and neighborhood

title: Im Supermarkt
context: You are shopping at a German supermarket. You can't find a product, ask staff for help, interact at checkout, and ask about the loyalty card.
context_tr: Alman süpermarketinde alışveriş yapıyorsunuz. Ürün bulamıyor, yardım istiyor ve kasada ödeme yapıyorsunuz.
opening: Kann ich Ihnen helfen?

title: Im Restaurant
context: You are dining at a German restaurant. You make a reservation, order food, ask about allergens, and pay the bill.
context_tr: Bir Alman restoranında yemek yiyorsunuz. Rezervasyon, sipariş ve ödeme yapıyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Abend! Haben Sie einen Tisch reserviert?
goals: Ask about allergens and pay the bill

title: In der Bäckerei
context: You are at a German bakery in the morning. You order bread, rolls, and a coffee. You ask about what is fresh and pay for your order.
context_tr: Sabah Alman fırınındasınız. Ekmek, küçük ekmek ve kahve ısmarlamak istiyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Morgen! Was darf es sein?

title: Beim Friseur
context: You visit a German hairdresser for the first time. You explain what you want done, how short, whether you want a wash, and react to the result.
context_tr: Alman kuaförüne ilk kez gidiyorsunuz. Ne istediğinizi anlatıyor, uzunluğu belirtiyorsunuz.
opening: Hallo! Willkommen! Was kann ich für Sie tun heute?

title: Bahnticket kaufen
context: You are at a Deutsche Bahn counter. You want to buy a ticket to another city, ask about connections, prices, and whether there are any discounts available.
context_tr: Deutsche Bahn gişesindeyseniz. Başka bir şehre bilet almak, aktarmalar ve indirimler hakkında soru sormak istiyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag! Wohin möchten Sie fahren?
goals: Buy a ticket to your destination
Ask about connections and travel time

title: Artikel zurückgeben
context: You bought something that is broken or not what you expected. You go back to the store to return or exchange it and ask for a refund.
context_tr: Aldığınız ürün bozuk ya da beklediğiniz gibi değil. Mağazaya iade veya değişim yapmak için gidiyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag! Wie kann ich Ihnen helfen?
goals: Explain the problem with the product
Ask for a refund or exchange

title: Nach dem Weg fragen
context: You are lost in a German city and ask a passerby for directions to the nearest U-Bahn station or a specific street.
context_tr: Alman şehrinde kayboluyorsunuz ve bir yabancıdan en yakın metro istasyonuna ya da belirli bir sokağa yolu soruyorsunuz.
opening: Hallo! Kann ich Ihnen helfen? Sie sehen etwas verloren aus.
goals: Ask clearly where you want to go

title: Neue Freunde kennenlernen
context: You are at an international meetup or language exchange event in Germany. You meet a German person and get to know each other naturally.
context_tr: Almanya'da uluslararası bir buluşma etkinliğindesiniz. Alman bir kişiyle tanışıp sohbet ediyorsunuz.
opening: Hallo! Ich habe dich noch nie hier gesehen. Bist du neu in der Stadt?
goals: Talk about why you are in Germany

vocabulary.translation: to come from (where are you from)

title: Auf einer Party
context: You are at a German colleague's house party. You don't know many people. You start a conversation with someone standing near you.
context_tr: Alman bir meslektaşınızın evindeki partidesiniz. Yanınızda duran biriyle sohbet başlatıyorsunuz.
opening: Hey! Kennst du hier viele Leute?
goals: Exchange contact details if it goes well

title: Sportverein beitreten
context: You want to join a local German sports club (Verein). You talk to the club secretary about membership, fees, training times, and what you need to bring.
context_tr: Yerel bir Alman spor kulübüne katılmak istiyorsunuz. Üyelik, ücretler ve antrenman saatleri hakkında konuşuyorsunuz.
opening: Hallo! Möchten Sie bei uns mitmachen?
goals: Ask about membership fees and conditions
Find out training times and location

title: Im Hobbyverein
context: You join a German hobby club — photography, painting, or hiking. It's your first meeting. Members introduce themselves and explain how the club works.
context_tr: Bir Alman hobi kulübüne katıldınız — fotoğraf, resim veya yürüyüş. İlk toplantınızdayken üyelerle tanışıyorsunuz.
opening: Oh, ein neues Gesicht! Herzlich willkommen! Ich bin Petra. Wie bist du zu uns gekommen?
goals: Introduce yourself and explain your interest
Ask how often the club meets

title: Erstes Date
context: You are on a first date with a German person at a café. You talk about each other's lives, interests, and share some humor. It is relaxed and friendly.
context_tr: Bir kafede Alman biriyle ilk randevunuzdayken. Yaşamlarınız ve ilgi alanlarınız hakkında konuşuyorsunuz.
opening: Hey, schön, dass du gekommen bist! Hattest du den Ort gut gefunden?

title: Portemonnaie verloren
context: You lost your wallet in a German city. You go to a police station or lost-and-found office to report it and ask for advice on what to do next.
context_tr: Alman şehrinde cüzdanınızı kaybettiniz. Polise bildiriyor ve ne yapmanız gerektiğini soruyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag. Was kann ich für Sie tun?
goals: Report the lost wallet and describe its contents
Find out what to do about your ID and cards

title: Bei der Polizei
context: You need to report a theft or an incident to the German police. You explain what happened, when, and give a description of the situation.
context_tr: Bir hırsızlık veya olayı Alman polisine bildirmeniz gerekiyor. Ne olduğunu, ne zaman olduğunu anlatıyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag. Nehmen Sie bitte Platz. Was ist passiert?

title: Zug verpasst
context: You missed your train due to a delay on the previous leg. You are at the DB service counter asking for help rebooking and finding the next connection.
context_tr: Önceki bağlantı gecikmesi nedeniyle trenizi kaçırdınız. DB gişesinde yeniden rezervasyon yaptırmaya çalışıyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag. Wie kann ich Ihnen helfen?
goals: Explain why you missed the train
Ask about the next available connection
Find out if you are entitled to a refund or rebooking

title: Ausgesperrt
context: You are locked out of your apartment at night. You call a locksmith (Schlüsseldienst) and your landlord to explain the situation and get help.
context_tr: Gece dairenizin dışında kilitli kaldınız. Çilingir ve ev sahibini arayarak durumu açıklıyorsunuz.
opening: Schlüsseldienst Schmidt, was kann ich für Sie tun?
goals: Explain you are locked out and give your address
Ask about the response time and cost
Understand what to do if it happens again

title: Autounfall
context: You were involved in a minor car accident. You exchange insurance details with the other driver and fill in the accident form (Unfallbericht).
context_tr: Küçük bir trafik kazasına karıştınız. Diğer sürücüyle sigorta bilgilerini paylaşıyor ve kaza tutanağını dolduruyorsunuz.
opening: Alles okay bei Ihnen? Zum Glück ist nichts Schlimmes passiert.
goals: Agree on what to note in the accident report

title: Arzt telefonisch anrufen
context: You call a German doctor's office to make an appointment. This is a phone call — you cannot see each other. The receptionist asks about your reason for calling and available times.
context_tr: Alman doktorunu randevu için telefonda arıyorsunuz. Görüntü yok, sadece ses. Resepsiyon şikayetinizi ve uygun saatleri soruyor.
opening: Praxis Dr. Müller, guten Tag!
goals: State your name and reason for calling

title: Vermieter telefonisch anrufen
context: You call your landlord on the phone to report a problem in the apartment — a leaking pipe or broken window. You explain the urgency.
context_tr: Ev sahibinizi telefonda arıyorsunuz. Dairede su sızıntısı veya kırık cam var. Aciliyeti anlatıyorsunuz.
opening: Ja, hallo?
goals: Describe the problem clearly by voice only
Agree on when someone will come to fix it

title: Versicherung anrufen
context: You call your health or liability insurance company on the phone. You want to ask about a claim, understand a letter you received, or change your personal details.
context_tr: Sağlık veya sorumluluk sigortanızı telefonda arıyorsunuz. Aldığınız mektup hakkında soruyorsunuz.
opening: AOK Kundenservice, guten Tag! Womit kann ich Ihnen helfen?
goals: Understand the answer and next steps

title: Kita telefonisch anrufen
context: You call your child's Kita to report that your child is sick and won't be coming today. You speak with the educator on the phone.
context_tr: Çocuğunuz hasta ve bugün gitmeyecek. Anaokulunu telefonda arıyor, durumu bildiriyorsunuz.
opening: Kita Sonnenschein, guten Morgen!
goals: Say your child's name and group
Ask when they need a sick note

title: Kundendienst anrufen
context: You call a German customer service hotline about a delivery that never arrived or a faulty product. You navigate the automated menu and speak with a representative.
context_tr: Gelmemiş kargo veya hatalı ürün için Alman müşteri hizmetlerini arıyorsunuz. Otomatik menüyü geçip bir temsilciyle konuşuyorsunuz.
opening: Hallo, Sie sind verbunden mit dem Kundenservice von Zalando. Mein Name ist Jonas. Wie kann ich Ihnen helfen?
goals: Explain your complaint clearly over the phone
Give your order number and personal details

title: Telefonisch Termin vereinbaren
context: You call an office or service provider to make an appointment. This could be a hairdresser, government office, or repair service. You negotiate a suitable time.
context_tr: Bir randevu almak için telefonda herhangi bir ofisi veya hizmet sağlayıcıyı arıyorsunuz. Uygun zamanı belirliyorsunuz.
opening: Guten Tag, womit kann ich Ihnen helfen?
goals: State the purpose of your call clearly
Confirm the appointment and write it down

title: Deutsche Direktheit
context: A German colleague gives you very direct, blunt feedback on your work without softening their words. They are not being rude — this is normal in German culture. Learn to respond calmly and professionally.
context_tr: Alman meslektaşınız size çok doğrudan, sert bir geri bildirim veriyor. Kaba değil, bu Alman kültüründe normaldir. Sakin ve profesyonel yanıt vermeyi öğrenin.
opening: Ich muss ehrlich sein — der Bericht war nicht gut. Die Struktur fehlt komplett und die Daten sind veraltet.
goals: Ask clarifying questions rather than defending yourself

title: Pünktlichkeit in Deutschland
context: You arrive 15 minutes late to a dinner invitation at a German friend's home. They open the door looking surprised. In Germany, punctuality is very important — even for social events.
context_tr: Alman arkadaşınızın yemek davetine 15 dakika geç kaldınız. Kapıyı şaşkın bir ifadeyle açtı. Almanya'da dakiklik sosyal etkinliklerde de çok önemlidir.
opening: Oh... du bist ja doch noch gekommen. Wir haben schon angefangen.
goals: Understand why it matters in German culture

vocabulary.translation: to let someone know in advance

title: Ruhezeiten einhalten
context: You are playing music on a Sunday afternoon. Your neighbor knocks on the door to remind you about Ruhezeiten (quiet hours). In Germany, Sundays are quiet days by law.
context_tr: Pazar öğleden sonra müzik çalıyorsunuz. Komşunuz kapınıza vuruyor ve Ruhezeiten (sessiz saatler) kuralını hatırlatıyor. Almanya'da Pazar günleri yasal olarak sakin günlerdir.
opening: Entschuldigung, ich möchte Sie auf etwas aufmerksam machen...
goals: Apologize and agree to be quiet
Ask about the exact quiet hours

title: Rechnung teilen (Getrennt zahlen)
context: After dinner with German friends, everyone wants to pay separately — this is very normal in Germany. You navigate this cultural difference and pay your share.
context_tr: Alman arkadaşlarla yemekten sonra herkes ayrı ayrı ödemiyor — bu Almanya'da tamamen normaldir. Bu kültürel farkı anlıyor ve payınızı ödüyorsunuz.
opening: Also, wir würden gerne getrennt zahlen. Ist das möglich?
goals: Understand when treating someone is appropriate

title: Bürokratisches Missverständnis
context: You are frustrated at a German office because you were told to bring documents, but now they say you need different ones. You try to resolve this calmly and diplomatically.
context_tr: Alman ofisinde hayal kırıklığı yaşıyorsunuz — belge getirmeniz söylendi ama şimdi farklı belgeler istiyorlar. Sakin ve diplomatik kalmaya çalışıyorsunuz.
opening: Tut mir leid, aber dieses Dokument reicht leider nicht aus. Sie brauchen zusätzlich eine beglaubigte Übersetzung.
goals: Explain what you were told before

title: Mülltrennung — Diskussion
context: A German neighbor catches you throwing something in the wrong bin and explains (quite seriously) why it matters. Germans take recycling very seriously.
context_tr: Alman komşunuz yanlış çöp kutusuna bir şey attığınızı görüyor ve neden önemli olduğunu (oldukça ciddiyetle) anlatıyor.
opening: Entschuldigung! Das darf man hier nicht! Das ist für den Restmüll, nicht für Plastik!
goals: Ask to understand the rules better
Show genuine willingness to do it right
